https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-news/play-a-limited-time-event-in-pokemon-pokopia-on-nintendo-switch-2

>F.A.Q

>Can I have more than one world in the same console?
Yes, you can have different saves for each profile. It's not like AC

>What about cloud saves?
Yes, unlike every other Pokemon game this one does support cloud saves

>Does it feature a real time clock? Can I change the console's date to progress faster?
Yes, there's no downside to moving forward or backwards

>Is my favorite Pokemon in?
List is still being updated https://www.serebii.net/pokemonpokopia/availablepokemon.shtml

>I didn't like ACNH, will I like this one?
Similarities with ACNH end at the UI, game is a lot faster, with more activities and a proper ~40h long story mode. If you've played DQ Builders 2 you know what you're getting into.

>Combat? Breakable tools?
No combat, no breakable tools. There's a stamina system in place very easy to manage.

item.description:
I'm one of the world's leading expert on home servers, self-hosting, and digital sovereignty. The concept I work with: everyone has a machine. That machine goes out and gets what counts as the internet for you, then you log into that machine and experience the internet through it, and through it alone. You don't connect to a public device; you connect to your private device, and your private device is tuned into a bunch of public things. Your main public-private machine doesn't move. But you do. Ask me anything.

item.title: [ 32] /nrl/ - Rugby League General - Thursday Night Footy - round 2
item.description:
Trouble in paradise edition

NRL
>GAME 1
Brisbane Broncos v Parramatta Eels
8:00pm AEDST on Fox, Kayo and Ch9
Suncorp Stadium, Brisbane
1.25-4.00
>Round 2 begins with the defending premiers looking to reverse last year's Round 21 upset by the Eels as Suncorp Stadium hosts a massive Thursday night encounter between two clubs desperate to erase memories of heavy Round 1 defeats. The Broncos endured a humbling start to their campaign, suffering a 0-26 shutout against the Penrith Panthers in front of their home fans. It was a stark departure from the high-energy football that defined their 2025 season, and coach Kevin Walters has responded by immediately reshuffling his spine to spark more creativity. The Parramatta Eels sit at the foot of the ladder following a devastating 4-52 thrashing by the Melbourne Storm. Their edge defence was particularly vulnerable, conceding nine tries in a performance that lacked physical intensity. The Eels now face the daunting prospect of an 0-2 start if they cannot rectify their structures before travelling to Brisbane. The Broncos have moved Ben Hunt to the bench, allowing Ezra Mam to return to the starting five-eighth role to partner Adam Reynolds. The Eels receive a boost with the return of Josh Addo-Carr, who has been cleared to play following thumb surgery His presence on the wing provides much-needed finishing ability for a side that managed only one try last week. In their most recent meeting in Round 21, 2025, the Eels secured a narrow 22-20 victory over the Broncos. Historically, Brisbane holds the advantage with 39 wins to Parramatta's 29, though the Eels have shown they can win at Suncorp Stadium with three victories in their last five visits.

item.description:
https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/07/us/politics/judge-kari-lake-voa-layoffs.html

A federal judge on Saturday ruled that the appointment of Kari Lake, the head of Voice of America’s oversight agency, was invalid, voiding mass layoffs that she had carried out at the federally funded news group last year.

The decision from Judge Royce C. Lamberth of the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia was a major rejection of President Trump’s attempts to dismantle the storied government-funded news group, which was founded to combat Nazi propaganda.

If upheld by higher courts, Judge Lamberth’s ruling would allow more than 1,000 journalists and support staff members at the news group to return to their jobs. Ms. Lake, who had been leading the U.S. Agency for Global Media, V.O.A.’s parent agency, said that she would appeal the decision.

Before Mr. Trump pushed to close the agency and influence its editorial decisions, Voice of America broadcast in 49 languages and had more than 360 million weekly listeners around the world, providing news services to foreign countries with limited press freedoms, such as China, Russia and Iran.

item.title: [247] /out/ings with a pipe
item.description:
Last thread >>2844498

This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent
an evening by the campfire with a pipe silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.
